name: Emily Dickinson

source.title: Poems by Emily Dickinson, Three Series, Complete
source.editors: Mabel Loomis Todd and T. W. Higginson
source.edition: First, Second and Third Series, 1890, 1891 and 1896, Roberts Brothers, Boston. Public domain.
source.note: Only the 1890s Todd and Higginson editions on Gutenberg are public domain. The Johnson (1955) and Franklin (1998) editions are under copyright and must not be used. Confirm the URL and edition against the downloaded file before building.

voice: Compressed and declarative. Short lines, often three to six words. Abstract nouns handled like physical objects: a grief with a weight, a noon with a door. One strange exact word beats three pretty ones. A capitalized noun mid-line is fine when it earns it. Her dashes are famous, but this project does not use em dashes; let the line break do the pausing, or use a comma.
